description: Read one UGC video by the id make_video answered, or change_video, make_longer, another_language or other_sizes answered for one: status queued, in_progress, ready or failed. While it is queued or in_progress, call it again about once a minute; ready and failed are final, a failed one with why. Each of its videos, by part, has its own status: a ready one its download_url and after_steps, the steps it offers next with their prices in credits, and a failed one whether its credits were refunded. Each ready video's download_url is made new in every answer and works for the next hour: its download_expires_in_seconds is the seconds it has left as that answer is made. For a later download, call get_video again for a new link. A product video's id is read with get_product_video. Free.
name: get_video
title: A video
